facebook.caption:
This place fixes something in you.

Dinh Cậu sits right at the edge of the water. A small shrine to the sea goddess, a blue-and-white lighthouse behind it, fishing boats drifting past. No entrance fee. No crowds at sunrise.

Locals come here to pray before heading out to sea. You come here and suddenly the trip slows down.

4.5 stars across 3,663 reviews. Go at golden hour. Stay longer than you planned.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
